name: Team Squirtle: Bulky Balance & Ground Inversion
archetype: Electric-immune Water/Ground starter tank, Ground/Flying aerial breaker, and status-immune Fighting/Poison pivots.
gym_duel_rationale: Lt. Surge enforces a strict 3v3 duel. Enter the arena with Wartortle/Geodude (Water/Ground typing inverts Water's greatest weakness into 100% Electric immunity, boasting 93 Base Defense with STAB Water Pulse and Magnitude), Dugtrio/Fearow (coveted Gliscor defensive typing with 100% immunity to both Electric and Ground, packing blazing 106 Speed), and Primeape/Gloom (Vital Spirit sleep immunity, resisting Water and Electric while punishing with Cross Chop and Mega Drain).

roster.progression_notes: Permanent starter anchor spliced with Mt. Moon Geodude. Inverts Water's greatest weakness into 100% Electric immunity while providing massive 93 Base Defense.

roster.status: Active in Party (Diglett's Cave & Route 9 Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Ground/Flying typing grants total immunity to both Electric and Ground. 106 Base Speed with STAB Magnitude and priority Sucker Punch.
Vital Spirit grants complete immunity to sleep. Resists both Electric and Water attacks while applying Sleep Powder and heavy Fighting STAB.
103 Special Attack glass cannon with dual Psychic/Poison typing. Sets Reflect screens and applies Sleep Powder.

roster.status: Active in Party (Old Rod & Mt. Moon Splice)
roster.progression_notes: 423 BST physical wall with 95 Defense and Water Absorb. Completely shuts down enemy Water attacks while providing Ground STAB.

flex_bench.why_use: Essential utility catcher with Compound Eyes Sleep Powder for capturing wild route assets.
Magic Guard prevents all passive hazard damage, while Fairy/Poison covers Fighting and Bug foes.

active_fusions: Wartortle/Geodude (Water/Ground starter anchor with 100% Electric immunity and 93 Defense)
Dugtrio/Fearow (Ground/Flying dual-immune speed sweeper with 106 Speed)
Kadabra/Bellsprout (103 SpA special artillery with Sleep Powder)
Poliwhirl/Sandslash (423 BST Water Absorb physical wall)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Visit the Vermilion City Poké Mart and pay $300 to unfuse Wartortle/Pikachu from Chapter 2, separating Wartortle.
2. Splice Wartortle with Mt. Moon Geodude to form Wartortle/Geodude, gaining 100% Electric immunity for the gym duel.
3. Catch Diglett in Diglett's Cave and splice with Fearow for an apex Ground/Flying dual-immune revenge killer.
upcoming_fusions: Blastoise/Fearow (Water/Flying neutral-to-grass rain tank with 4x STAB Drill Peck for Erika)
Flareon/Sandslash (110 Attack Fire/Ground wallbreaker via Celadon Fire Stone)
